question: Is there a United States planting window source, readable without a login, whose windows a third party could defend?
method: One request per address from this host with a browser like User-Agent, redirects followed, 90 second timeout. Status, content type, byte count and sha256 of the body are recorded. Bodies are kept under raw/ next to this file's build scripts.

probes.note: ArcGIS Online search for an RMA date layer
probes.excerpt: {"total":0,"start":1,"num":10,"nextStart":-1,"results":[]}
probes.verdict_reason: ArcGIS Online search returns an empty result set, so no public RMA date layer is published there.
